svg.title: TurboQuant stores float32 vectors at 16, 8, or 4 bits per dimension
svg.desc: You upload regular float32 vectors, which use 32 bits per dimension. TurboQuant rotates them, then rounds them to an integer grid at the size you pick: turbo16 at 16 bits per dimension has the same recall as float32, turbo8 at 8 bits comes close to float16, and turbo4 at 4 bits is smallest, but recall can drop.
